subject: Board meeting connectivity ops plan and room reservation
messages:
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Conference Ops <conference-ops@landmarkhotels.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Board meeting connectivity ops plan and room reservation

Hi team,

We need to lock the room and AV plan for the PartnerCorp board session on Aug 5 (09:00-15:00). Priority items: seating for 28 (u-shape preferred), hybrid bridge for 6 remote execs (mix of SIP and Zoom), two ceiling mics (Shure MXA910 preferred), one hardware codec (H.323/SIP) + backup laptop with native Zoom client, and a test window the morning of Aug 4 (preferred 08:00-09:00).

Questions for Conference Ops: can you confirm Pacific A availability and provide the on-site tech POC and AV inventory (mics, codec, cameras, switch ports)? We need a separate VLAN for the bridge with QoS; please confirm if the venue can provide.

I've attached a rough seating/layout options and the exec travel manifest (will update).

Next steps:
- Venue confirms room + AV inventory (Conference Ops)
- Marissa to confirm attendee arrivals and hotel logistics
- Laura to confirm site access and badges
- Conference Ops to confirm test window and on-site tech name

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: venue_av_inventory_20260711.pdf, exec_travel_manifest_20260711.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board meeting connectivity ops plan and room reservation

Karthik —

Pacific A is tentatively available but max seating with U-shape is 24. If we need 28 with U-shape, we should either: switch to Pacific B (adjacent, slightly larger) or use Pacific A with theater + two tables at front for execs (less ideal for discussion).

I recommend Pacific B for the U-shape. Pacific B has ceiling rig points and two 3-phase outlets near stage (useful for codec+AV cart).

Marissa: if we move to Pacific B, can you confirm the attendee list and whether board members require private green room access? I can request an extra security badge and a short escort route.

Laura
Director, Workplace Experience
Redwood Inference
From: Conference Ops <conference-ops@landmarkhotels.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board meeting connectivity ops plan and room reservation

Hi Karthik / Laura / Marissa,

Thanks for reaching out — we have Pacific B available on Aug 5 and can accommodate a U-shape for 30 pax. Details below: 

- On-site tech: Diego Ramos (diego.ramos@landmarkhotels.com) / +1 415-555-0189
- AV inventory (standard): 2x Shure MXA910, 1x Poly Studio X50 (can provision hardware codec), 2x PTZ cameras (Sony SRG-300), 1x HDMI matrix, 1x 24-port managed switch
- Network: can provision a dedicated VLAN with static IPs and QoS. We will need the SIP/H.323 IPs and MAC of any codec devices 48hrs prior to event.
- Bridge options: native Zoom (venue will open a Zoom host account), SIP gateway via BlueBridge (ops@bluebridge.io) if you prefer SIP dialing.
- Test window: Aug 4 08:00-09:00 confirmed for streaming and SIP dial-in test. Please confirm by July 20.

We can pre-stage AV cart the evening before (Aug 4) and hold it in secure storage. Catering and green room access can be coordinated separately.

Attached: venue_av_inventory_20260711.pdf (detailed kit), site_map_cabling.png

Best,
Conference Ops
Landmark Hotels
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Conference Ops <conference-ops@landmarkhotels.com>, BlueBridge Support <ops@bluebridge.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board meeting connectivity ops plan and room reservation

Thanks — Pacific B works. A few clarifications and asks: 

1) Please reserve 2x Shure MXA910 ceiling arrays and a Poly/Codec that supports SIP and native Zoom. If BlueBridge needs to broker SIP<>Zoom, coordinate with them and confirm SIP dial string (we will give static IPs).
2) Can you provide a dedicated wired line for the hardware codec and a second wired line for the presenter laptop (no NAT).
3) On-site arrival times: execs arrive Aug 4 between 17:30-19:00 for dinner; we request the AV cart be brought to the room for a quick smoke test at 18:30.
4) Please ensure Diego brings spare HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C, and a pair of 1/4" TRS adapters for older audio gear.
5) We will supply a backup meeting laptop (MacBook Pro M2 + HDMI dongle). Please confirm that the venue can accept our laptop and that your switch will allow multicast if needed.

Marissa - included updated exec travel manifest (attached). Laura - please confirm site access for Aug 4 evening and badge pickup for Diego.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: exec_travel_manifest_20260711.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Conference Ops <conference-ops@landmarkhotels.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board meeting connectivity ops plan and room reservation

All good from travel side — flights and hotel are booked for the execs: 
- Steve Mason (PartnerCorp) AA 872, arrives Aug 4 18:05 SFO
- Other board members arriving 17:40-19:20, will list in final manifest tonight.

Diego / Conference Ops: please plan to run the Aug 4 18:30 smoke test once the AV cart is staged. Can you also confirm that the ceiling mics will be left powered overnight (we need them online for the 08:00 test)?

Catering update: light boxed lunches for Aug 5 (no hot buffet) — otherwise green room setups remain the same.

Marissa
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@landmarkhotels.com>, Conference Ops <conference-ops@landmarkhotels.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, BlueBridge Support <ops@bluebridge.io>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board meeting connectivity ops plan and room reservation

All set — moving forward with Pacific B, test windows confirmed (Aug 4 08:00-09:00 + Aug 4 18:30 smoke test). Diego, please confirm you will be on-site Aug 4 17:30-19:00 and bring spare HDMI, DP, USB-C, and two 1/4" adapters. Also please confirm you will leave the ceiling mics powered overnight.

BlueBridge / Ops: please share the SIP dial string and testing steps so we can hand it to our IT contact (cc'ed: laura_bennett).

If no changes by July 20 we will proceed with bookings and final distributions.

Thanks — K
